resources.string: Raven VPN uses Android VpnService to route your internet traffic through an encrypted tunnel to the node you choose.

While connected, the selected node forwards your traffic to its destinations. The configured DNS resolver receives the domain names your device asks it to look up. Encryption between your device and the VPN node ends at that node. Apps such as browsers can use HTTPS to encrypt traffic to their destinations.

Raven VPN uses an app-generated installation ID and your chosen node to set up access and allocate a tunnel session. It uses session timing and total transferred bytes to enforce time and data limits.
Agree to load VPN nodes. After you choose a node and tap Protect, Android may ask you to allow the VPN connection.
